notes.title: Nominate Ultra Age for the Steam Awards 2022!
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

The Steam Awards 2022 are right around the corner and we'd like to encourage fans of Ultra Age to nominate it for the [b]Labor of Love Award[/b]!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41050533/3bd342394036b28a2138b82a2fb3bb6a57c8e925.png[/img]

In September, we released [b]Ultra Age Rebirth Project[/b], a completely new rogue-lite side game with loads of content that can be accessed from the game's main menu after the player has reached a certain point in the main game. Rebirth Project adds a completely separate game experience to Ultra Age with an enhanced skill and weapon upgrade system, improved affinities for blades, new enemies and bosses, and tons of items to unlock. Players can challenge themselves and hone their skills in Rebirth Project, providing hours and hours of gameplay...for free!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2064450/Ultra_Age__Rebirth_Project/

In addition to the numerous patches we've released to improve gameplay, performance and balance in difficulty, we've also completely re-hauled the graphics and English voice acting since to launch to create an even better gameplay experience overall. 

And! Don't forget about the free Digital Concept Artbook attached to the Steam release! :)

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2065470/Ultra_Age__Digital_Concept_Artbook/

If you feel the above constitutes a nomination for Labor of Love, we'd be honored if you'd consider nominating Ultra Age. 

Thank you so much for the continued support!

notes.title: Free DLC 'Rebirth Project' released today!
notes.content:
Attention Ultra Age fans!

Ultra Age's additional content [b]'Rebirth Project'[/b] has released today.

[list]
[*][h3]Introducing[/h3]
Age was exploring a portal in the Frontier Shelter when he was suddenly moved to what appears to be a laboratory by an unknown force. It seems to be a laboratory of the Frontier meant for testing creatures, filled with many devices to measure and record combat capabilities and strengthen their shortcomings.  All experimental subjects created from these repeated experiments are beings who seek perfection, created solely from data.

Age becomes a reincarnation constantly reborn by Helvis in the laboratory each time a 'different Age' participates in an experiment... An experiment that cannot be escaped until it is fully completed. Will Age be able to escape from the 'Rebirth Project'?
[/list]

This DLC is free, so all players can experience the Ultra Age style rogue-like level.

[b]Note[/b]
The game itself has also updated. If you didn't see DLC menu although the game cleared, please update the game.

Please enjoy!

notes.title: Out Now! Improvements of the PC Version of Ultra Age
notes.content:
Heads up! Ultra Age is out now on Steam! Experience this definitive version of the game with the following improvements over its 2021 release on consoles!

[u][b]Improved Graphics, Stable FPS Experience[/b][/u]
Ultra Age uses Unreal Engine 4 to express a realistic future world and environment, giving gamers a strong sense of immersion. The PC version improves the overall appearance quality of background and chapter graphics. Some sections have incorporated lighting and post-processing effects. 
In addition, the appearance of the main character 'Age' has been revamped and improved. 
FPS remains stable for 60 frames, even in various environments in the game. We also added graphic and frame options for a variety of PC environments.

[u][b]Play More Comfortably[/b][/u]
Ultra Age allows you to flow through many combos in fast, stylish actions with numerous blades. We've refined the difficulty system to allow more gamers to play at ease and have improved the level design. We've also added save points and energy crystals for more recovery opportunities.

[u][b]Completely New Voiceovers[/b][/u]
For the release of the PC version, we have completely re-recorded all English and Japanese voices in the game. With this new, more realistic dialogue, we hope gamers can have an even more immersive experience.

*Please note the above improvements are planned to be implemented into console versions eventually as well.

notes.title: Ultra Age slashes its way onto Steam on April 28th!
notes.content:
Mark your calendars! Ultra Age will be released on Steam on April 28th! 

The Steam version will incorporate a number of improvements over its previous release on consoles. Graphically, the overall quality of backgrounds in all chapters of the game will be improved, including an overhaul of the appearance of the main character, Age. We have also improved the framerate, added graphics options, adjusted the level design and difficulty, and fixed some aspects of gameplay for a more comfortable experience!

The English and Japanese voiceovers have been completely re-recorded to increase the immersive feeling of the game. Bug fixes and various in-game options for PC users have also been added.

Developer Next Stage / Visual Dart have also announced that in addition to general improvements, they are preparing a free DLC to enrich the way the game is played. The DLC will provide content for players who have cleared the story mode of the game, such as logged game play, new character growth methods with various choices, the addition of collector elements, and more. The DLC will be released for free this summer!

In case you missed it, the developers held an [url=https://youtu.be/yak6zd0OA0c]Ultra Age Roadmap Conference[/url] in conjunction with the release date announcement on April 21st. Feel free to check it out!
[previewyoutube=yak6zd0OA0c;full][/previewyoutube]
Ultra Age captures the high-speed character action genre with a blend of fast-paced action with multiple weapons and skill customization set on a futuristic Earth. You play as Age, a sword-wielding soldier sent on a mission to save humanity from destruction. Using a variety of blades, you can execute fast, stylish combos, perform air combos and enemy pulls, and deliver devastating break blade attacks to annihilate foes. Gather resources to strengthen your weapons, expand your skills, learn new combos and level up Age and his android, Helvis.

Ultra Age is a high-speed action title developed by Korea-based indie game company Next Stage and graphic specialist company Visual Dart. In development for over four years, Ultra Age was released for PlayStation®4 and Nintendo Switch™ on September 9th, 2021. Developed with Unreal Engine 4, Ultra Age attracted considerable attention at the time of its console release, showing excellent action and gameplay elements that push the boundaries of indie games.
